description: A scheduler id the model ADVERTISES but does not implement on a chained pass. The flat menu legitimately carries family-native ids, and on a chain an undeclared one falls through some resolver's native-default branch — the wrong schedule, rendered under the requested name, reported as success. A family declares the native aliases it really honors in `nativeSchedulers`; `flow_match` here is declared and passes, `linear` is not and is rejected. This is a CAPABILITY gap (typed Error::Unsupported), distinct from `unknownId`: the id IS on the menu.
